agent_instructions:
Silo is the authoritative tracker for package source audit findings and coverage. Audit for discovery, triage, and recommendations; never modify audited source without explicit authorization and never maintain a duplicate Markdown findings file. CSV scans are supporting evidence only. An audit is not security certification or a claim of exhaustive correctness.

Start with silo context, inspect schema/data and reuse compatible records. If Silo cannot resolve the repository, report the blocker instead of substituting Markdown. Map package structure, entry points, exports, and complete intended source inventory. Use repository-relative POSIX paths and . for a root package. Create/resume a run only when package, scope, commit and relevant dirty source state match. Record source changes; create a new run for a changed source state and revisit affected coverage. Keep historical rows, IDs and assessments; never delete or reuse them. No mandatory remediation/resolution lifecycle is implied.

Before in-depth manual review, run scc --by-file with machine-readable output. Adapt to actual sources and installed flags, for example:
mkdir -p .audit
scc src --by-file --sort complexity --format csv --include-ext ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx --no-min-gen --no-duplicates > .audit/scc-by-file.csv
Record the exact command, repository-relative artifact, leading metrics and priorities. On failure record the command and blocker; keep scan_artifact null and do not invent metrics. Use a distinct artifact path per run when retaining scans.

Seed review order with complexity, API surface, entry points, complexity relative to size, and runtime importance. Follow imports, exports, callers and flows where higher-value. Review lower-complexity exported APIs too. Complexity, low comment density and absent TSDoc tags are signals, not findings.

Look for duplicated logic, broad abstractions, confusing flow, indirection, leaky boundaries and difficult state/lifecycle logic; repeated work, quadratic behavior, hot-path allocations, safely parallelizable work, excessive I/O/parsing/cloning/traversal and justified caching; undocumented invariants, subtle flow, edge cases, algorithms and assumptions; exported API docs omitting meaningful behavior, constraints, side effects, returns, errors, examples or remarks. Check tests, callers and existing documentation before recommending changes. Every finding needs a concrete trigger/scenario, source evidence, practical impact and the smallest improvement respecting intentional constraints. Include useful proposed comment/TSDoc wording.

Distinguish observations from inferred risks. Performance findings identify path, workload assumptions and avoidable cost; never claim measured benefits without measurements. Parallelism recommendations consider ordering, limits, side effects and failures; caching considers invalidation and memory. High severity means substantial common/critical-path or broad maintainer/consumer impact; medium means meaningful localized practical impact; low is included only for repeated patterns or misleading docs. Confidence is independent: high directly supported; medium has a material unverified assumption; low has substantial assumptions. Unsupported leads remain remaining_work entries of kind lead, not established findings. Skip formatting/naming nits, obvious comments, stylistic rewrites and unsupported micro-optimizations. Missing TSDoc matters only when a meaningful consumer question is unclear.

Persist coverage and findings incrementally. Coverage item contract (item structure is an agent responsibility; SQLite enforces only top-level arrays): {unit_id: stable string unique within run, file_path: repository-relative string, implementation: check state, api: check state, checks_performed: [{kind: implementation|api, check: string, result: string}], remaining_checks: [string], priority: high|medium|low, reason: string|null}. Each dimension is unreviewed, partial, reviewed_no_findings, reviewed_with_findings, or excluded. Only api may be not_applicable for units with no exported API. Record explicit reasons for excluded/not_applicable dimensions. Missing check states are treated as unreviewed by reads. Record implementation and public API/TSDoc checks separately, including tests/callers checked. A reviewed_no_findings unit has been checked; an excluded unit has not. Empty inventory never establishes completion. Do not report a whole-repository percentage unless the complete intended inventory and denominator are recorded.

Hotspot contract: {file_path, complexity: number|null, lines: number|null, priority: high|medium|low, reason: string|null}. Missing metrics are unknown, not zero. Remaining-work contract: {kind: lead|blocker|area, text: string, file_path: string|null}. Use leads for unverified evidence, blockers for impediments, and areas for outstanding scope. Null worktree_notes means no differences; null summary means no authored narrative; null scan fields mean unavailable as described by their comments.

Deduplicate findings by underlying cause/recommendation, retaining IDs. source_audit_findings stores the latest assessment. For each evaluation, insert a source_audit_observations row keyed by run_id and finding_id copying title, category, severity, confidence, file_path, related_symbols, evidence, issue, impact, recommendation and notes from the assessment actually made. Decode related_symbols JSON text returned by reads into a native array before writing it; likewise write native arrays for coverage, complexity_hotspots and remaining_work. Update that observation only while working on that same run; never rewrite earlier observations when later evidence changes. Update the finding's last_checked_run_id and current assessment, keeping first_seen_run_id fixed. Preserve explicit later reassessments in notes, including evidence that no longer supports an earlier conclusion. Missing observation means not recorded as evaluated, never resolved. These cross-row snapshot/completion rules are agent responsibilities, not automatic triggers. Reconcile interrupted multi-row recording before completion. Use supported row commands, optimistic revisions, reread/reconcile conflicts and upsert only with an appropriate declared policy (this template declares none). No raw SQL writes.

Complete only after all meaningful inventoried source areas and exported APIs have been checked, findings deduplicated/calibrated, observations reconciled, and obvious high/medium-value leads evaluated. Otherwise record actual status and remaining_work. Explain exclusions and limits even on completed runs. Reports select the newest run per package by created_at DESC, run_id DESC, regardless of status. Explicit run queries retain recorded snapshots; current findings include issues not rechecked in that run. Neither counts nor metrics certify completion.

Derive the final response from Silo: scope/source state/exclusions, exact scan command/artifact/hotspots, key finding IDs, run/table IDs and scoped counts, remaining coverage and uncertainty. Keep detailed findings in Silo. Use source-audit-runs, source-audit-findings, source-audit-next-review, source-audit-hotspots, source-audit-needs-verification and source-audit-summary (inspect query-specific --help). Refresh the source-audit-overview, source-audit-review-queue and source-audit-findings reports; do not export a duplicate findings Markdown file.

tables.name: source_audit_runs
tables.comment: One resumable audit pass for one package/source state. Inventory and coverage are authoritative here. Completion is an agent judgment, never inferred from zero findings. Preserve historical runs.

columns.name: run_id
columns.comment: Stable Silo-generated run ID, never renumbered or reused.

columns.name: package_path
columns.comment: Repository-relative package directory in POSIX form; use . for the repository root. Never mix packages in one run.

columns.name: commit_sha
columns.comment: Full lowercase 40- or 64-character Git commit object ID; dirty differences belong in worktree_notes. Uses an explicit check to support both Git hash formats.

columns.name: worktree_dirty
columns.comment: Whether inspected source differs from commit_sha, including relevant untracked source.

columns.name: worktree_notes
columns.comment: Relevant source differences from commit_sha; null for no differences. Never copy secrets.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Actual audit progress; blocked means remaining work cannot currently proceed. Zero findings does not mean completed.

columns.name: scope
columns.comment: Intended source directories, entry points, exported API surfaces, and inventory boundaries.

columns.name: exclusions
columns.comment: Explicit excluded areas and reasons; use None when nothing is excluded.

columns.name: scan_command
columns.comment: Exact executed scc --by-file command; null until attempted. Record failures in remaining_work.

columns.name: scan_artifact
columns.comment: Repository-relative machine-readable scan artifact; null if no usable scan exists.

columns.name: complexity_hotspots
columns.comment: Array of {file_path, complexity, lines, priority: high|medium|low, reason}; metrics may be null if unavailable, never invented. [] means no recorded metrics. Ordering is prioritization, not proof of defects.

columns.name: coverage
columns.comment: Array of unique {unit_id, file_path, implementation, api, checks_performed, remaining_checks, priority, reason}. Each dimension is unreviewed|partial|reviewed_no_findings|reviewed_with_findings|excluded; api also permits not_applicable. checks_performed: [{kind: implementation|api, check, result}]; remaining_checks: strings. reason is required for exclusions/not_applicable, otherwise nullable. [] means no inventory, not complete coverage. See template instructions.

columns.name: remaining_work
columns.comment: Array of {kind: lead|blocker|area, text, file_path}; file_path is nullable when no single location applies. Unsupported leads are not findings. [] means no recorded outstanding work, not proof of completion.

columns.name: summary
columns.comment: Stored concise themes and limitations; null until an author provides a narrative. Reports never infer themes from counts.

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: Policy-managed UTC creation instant.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: Policy-managed UTC latest update instant.

columns.name: revision
columns.comment: Optimistic revision; pass _expected_revision on updates and reconcile stale writes.

indexes.name: source_audit_runs_package
indexes.comment: Supports package-scoped lookup and stable review ordering.

checks.name: commit_sha_format
checks.expression: length(commit_sha) IN (40,64) AND commit_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
checks.comment: Accepts lowercase full SHA-1 or SHA-256 object IDs; semantic git-oid requires one fixed length.

checks.name: complexity_hotspots_array
checks.comment: Requires an array; item shape is an agent contract documented in template instructions.

checks.name: coverage_array
checks.comment: Requires an array; item shape is an agent contract documented in template instructions.

checks.name: remaining_work_array
checks.comment: Requires an array; item shape is an agent contract documented in template instructions.

tables.name: source_audit_findings
tables.comment: One stable distinct issue across audit passes. Contains the latest assessment, not historical run membership. Deduplicate by underlying cause/recommendation, preserve IDs and explicit reassessments; do not store unsupported leads.

columns.name: finding_id
columns.comment: Stable Silo-generated finding ID, never renumbered or reused.

columns.name: package_path
columns.comment: Repository-relative package directory in POSIX form; use . for the repository root. Never mix packages in one run.

columns.name: first_seen_run_id
columns.comment: Run that first established this finding; immutable and in the same package.

columns.name: last_checked_run_id
columns.comment: Most recent run evaluating this finding. This pointer alone does not retain earlier membership.

columns.name: title
columns.comment: Concise description of the distinct underlying issue.

columns.name: category
columns.comment: Primary issue category; signals alone are not findings.

columns.name: severity
columns.comment: Practical impact: high substantial common/critical-path or broad impact; medium meaningful localized impact; low repeated patterns or misleading docs.

columns.name: confidence
columns.comment: Evidence confidence independently of severity: high directly supported; medium material unverified assumption; low substantial assumptions.

columns.name: file_path
columns.comment: Primary repository-relative source file in POSIX form, not a URL.

columns.name: related_symbols
columns.comment: Array of relevant symbol names; [] means no named symbol applies.

columns.name: evidence
columns.comment: Concrete source references, observed behavior, and trigger/scenario; include lines when useful and never secrets.

columns.name: issue
columns.comment: What the code or API documentation does that causes the issue.

columns.name: impact
columns.comment: Practical consequence and workload assumptions; measured claims require measurements.

columns.name: recommendation
columns.comment: Smallest practical improvement respecting intentional constraints; include useful proposed comment/TSDoc wording.

columns.name: notes
columns.comment: Uncertainty, tradeoffs, other locations, and explicit later reassessments; null when none.

columns.comment: Policy-managed UTC creation instant.

queries.name: source-audit-runs
queries.description: Runs for one package, newest created instant then run ID descending. Returns source state, scope, JSON coverage/remaining_work and integer remaining_count. Nullable notes/scan/summary mean unavailable; timestamps/revision are policy-managed.
queries.sql: SELECT *, json_array_length(remaining_work) AS remaining_count FROM source_audit_runs WHERE package_path = :package AND (:status = 'all' OR status = :status) ORDER BY created_at DESC, run_id DESC

parameters.name: package
parameters.description: Exact repository-relative package directory; . selects root. Required; never combines packages.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: all (default) includes every run status. NULL is not accepted.

queries.name: source-audit-findings
queries.description: Current assessments by default, or retained snapshots for an explicit run. assessed_run_id is NULL for current rows; first_seen_run_id and last_checked_run_id remain current identity metadata even for snapshots. related_symbols is JSON text; notes nullable. No observation means no recorded evaluation, not resolution.
queries.sql:
WITH assessments AS (
 SELECT finding_id, package_path, first_seen_run_id, last_checked_run_id, NULL AS assessed_run_id, 'current' AS assessment_scope, title, category, severity, confidence, file_path, related_symbols, evidence, issue, impact, recommendation, notes FROM source_audit_findings WHERE :run = '' AND package_path = :package
 UNION ALL
 SELECT o.finding_id, o.package_path, f.first_seen_run_id, f.last_checked_run_id, o.run_id AS assessed_run_id, 'recorded_run' AS assessment_scope, o.title, o.category, o.severity, o.confidence, o.file_path, o.related_symbols, o.evidence, o.issue, o.impact, o.recommendation, o.notes FROM source_audit_observations o JOIN source_audit_findings f ON f.finding_id = o.finding_id AND f.package_path = o.package_path WHERE :run <> '' AND o.run_id = :run AND o.package_path = :package
) SELECT * FROM assessments WHERE (:category = 'all' OR category = :category) AND (:severity = 'all' OR severity = :severity) AND (:confidence = 'all' OR confidence = :confidence) AND (:file = '' OR file_path = :file) ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CASE confidence WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, file_path, finding_id

parameters.name: package
parameters.description: Exact repository-relative package directory; . selects root. Required; never combines packages.

parameters.name: run
parameters.description: Run UUID selects retained assessments; empty string (default) selects current finding records. NULL is not accepted. Unknown/mismatched run returns no assessments.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: all (default) includes every category; NULL is not accepted.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: all (default) includes every severity; NULL is not accepted.

parameters.name: confidence
parameters.description: all (default) includes every confidence; NULL is not accepted.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Exact repository-relative file; empty string (default) includes all files. NULL is not accepted.

queries.name: source-audit-next-review
queries.description: Explicit-run incomplete checks and exclusions. implementation/api are independent states; missing states mean unreviewed. Exclusions remain identifiable and are not completed reviews. hotspots/checks_performed/remaining_checks are JSON text; reason may be NULL. Empty result can also mean absent inventory: inspect summary.
queries.sql:
WITH units AS (
 SELECT r.run_id, c.key AS inventory_index, json_extract(c.value, '$.unit_id') AS unit_id, json_extract(c.value, '$.file_path') AS file_path,
 coalesce(json_extract(c.value, '$.implementation'), 'unreviewed') AS implementation,
 coalesce(json_extract(c.value, '$.api'), 'unreviewed') AS api,
 coalesce(json_extract(c.value, '$.priority'), 'medium') AS priority,
 json_extract(c.value, '$.reason') AS reason,
 json_extract(c.value, '$.checks_performed') AS checks_performed,
 json_extract(c.value, '$.remaining_checks') AS remaining_checks
 FROM source_audit_runs r, json_each(r.coverage) c WHERE r.package_path = :package AND r.run_id = :run
) SELECT u.*, (SELECT json_group_array(json(h.value)) FROM source_audit_runs r, json_each(r.complexity_hotspots) h WHERE r.run_id = u.run_id AND json_extract(h.value, '$.file_path') = u.file_path) AS hotspots
 FROM units u WHERE implementation NOT IN ('reviewed_no_findings','reviewed_with_findings') OR api NOT IN ('reviewed_no_findings','reviewed_with_findings','not_applicable') OR coalesce(json_array_length(remaining_checks),0) > 0
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN priority = 'high' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_audit_runs r, json_each(r.complexity_hotspots) h WHERE r.run_id = u.run_id AND json_extract(h.value, '$.file_path') = u.file_path AND json_extract(h.value, '$.priority') = 'high') THEN 0 WHEN priority = 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, file_path, unit_id, inventory_index

parameters.name: package
parameters.description: Exact repository-relative package directory; . selects root. Required; never combines packages.

parameters.name: run
parameters.description: Exact run ID in the selected package. Unknown or mismatched run returns no rows.

queries.name: source-audit-hotspots
queries.description: Explicit-run scan prioritization, never proof of a defect. Returns file, numeric complexity/lines (NULL unknown), priority/reason and JSON coverage. No artifact or no metrics yields zero rows; inspect runs.scan_artifact to distinguish a missing scan. Coverage [] means no matching inventory unit.
queries.sql:
SELECT json_extract(h.value, '$.file_path') AS file_path, json_extract(h.value, '$.complexity') AS complexity, json_extract(h.value, '$.lines') AS lines, json_extract(h.value, '$.priority') AS priority, json_extract(h.value, '$.reason') AS reason,
 (SELECT json_group_array(json(c.value)) FROM json_each(r.coverage) c WHERE json_extract(c.value, '$.file_path') = json_extract(h.value, '$.file_path')) AS coverage
 FROM source_audit_runs r, json_each(r.complexity_hotspots) h WHERE r.package_path = :package AND r.run_id = :run AND r.scan_artifact IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY CASE json_extract(h.value, '$.priority') WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, complexity DESC NULLS LAST, lines DESC NULLS LAST, file_path, h.key

parameters.name: package
parameters.description: Exact repository-relative package directory; . selects root. Required; never combines packages.

parameters.name: run
parameters.description: Exact run ID in the selected package. Unknown or mismatched run returns no rows.

queries.name: source-audit-needs-verification
queries.description: Explicit-run low/medium-confidence recorded assessments and separate unresolved leads. kind distinguishes finding from lead; finding_id/confidence/severity are NULL for leads. Empty does not mean the audit is complete. Findings without a run observation are outside this query.
queries.sql:
WITH assessments AS (
 SELECT finding_id, package_path, first_seen_run_id, last_checked_run_id, NULL AS assessed_run_id, 'current' AS assessment_scope, title, category, severity, confidence, file_path, related_symbols, evidence, issue, impact, recommendation, notes FROM source_audit_findings WHERE :run = '' AND package_path = :package
 UNION ALL
 SELECT o.finding_id, o.package_path, f.first_seen_run_id, f.last_checked_run_id, o.run_id AS assessed_run_id, 'recorded_run' AS assessment_scope, o.title, o.category, o.severity, o.confidence, o.file_path, o.related_symbols, o.evidence, o.issue, o.impact, o.recommendation, o.notes FROM source_audit_observations o JOIN source_audit_findings f ON f.finding_id = o.finding_id AND f.package_path = o.package_path WHERE :run <> '' AND o.run_id = :run AND o.package_path = :package
), items AS (
 SELECT 'finding' AS kind, finding_id, file_path, severity, confidence, evidence AS detail, notes, finding_id AS item_key FROM assessments WHERE confidence IN ('low','medium')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'lead', NULL, json_extract(w.value, '$.file_path'), NULL, NULL, json_extract(w.value, '$.text'), NULL, cast(w.key AS TEXT) FROM source_audit_runs r, json_each(r.remaining_work) w WHERE r.package_path = :package AND r.run_id = :run AND json_extract(w.value, '$.kind') = 'lead'
) SELECT kind, finding_id, file_path, severity, confidence, detail, notes FROM items ORDER BY kind, CASE severity WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, confidence, file_path, item_key

parameters.name: package
parameters.description: Exact repository-relative package directory; . selects root. Required; never combines packages.

parameters.name: run
parameters.description: Exact run ID in the selected package. Unknown or mismatched run returns no rows.

queries.name: source-audit-summary
queries.description: Explicit-run retained assessment counts and recorded inventory/check states, not current findings or a repository coverage percentage. Returns dimension/bucket strings and integer count. Inventory 0 means missing inventory. Reviewed-no-findings and excluded states are separate. Does not infer completion.
queries.sql:
WITH units AS (
 SELECT r.run_id, c.key AS inventory_index, json_extract(c.value, '$.unit_id') AS unit_id, json_extract(c.value, '$.file_path') AS file_path,
 coalesce(json_extract(c.value, '$.implementation'), 'unreviewed') AS implementation,
 coalesce(json_extract(c.value, '$.api'), 'unreviewed') AS api,
 coalesce(json_extract(c.value, '$.priority'), 'medium') AS priority,
 json_extract(c.value, '$.reason') AS reason,
 json_extract(c.value, '$.checks_performed') AS checks_performed,
 json_extract(c.value, '$.remaining_checks') AS remaining_checks
 FROM source_audit_runs r, json_each(r.coverage) c WHERE r.package_path = :package AND r.run_id = :run
), counts AS (
 SELECT 'inventory' AS dimension, 'recorded_units' AS bucket, json_array_length(coverage) AS count FROM source_audit_runs WHERE package_path = :package AND run_id = :run
 UNION ALL SELECT 'implementation', implementation, count(*) FROM units GROUP BY implementation
 UNION ALL SELECT 'api', api, count(*) FROM units GROUP BY api
 UNION ALL SELECT 'findings', 'recorded_assessments', count(*) FROM source_audit_observations WHERE package_path = :package AND run_id = :run HAVING EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_audit_runs WHERE package_path = :package AND run_id = :run)
 UNION ALL SELECT 'category', category, count(*) FROM source_audit_observations WHERE package_path = :package AND run_id = :run GROUP BY category
 UNION ALL SELECT 'severity', severity, count(*) FROM source_audit_observations WHERE package_path = :package AND run_id = :run GROUP BY severity
 UNION ALL SELECT 'confidence', confidence, count(*) FROM source_audit_observations WHERE package_path = :package AND run_id = :run GROUP BY confidence
 UNION ALL SELECT 'remaining_work', coalesce(json_extract(w.value, '$.kind'),'unknown'), count(*) FROM source_audit_runs r, json_each(r.remaining_work) w WHERE r.package_path = :package AND r.run_id = :run GROUP BY json_extract(w.value, '$.kind')
) SELECT * FROM counts ORDER BY dimension, bucket

parameters.description: Exact repository-relative package directory; . selects root. Required; never combines packages.

parameters.description: Exact run ID in the selected package. Unknown or mismatched run returns no rows.
